name: Google Landmark Retrieval - 1st Place (2020) - Pipeline Template
summary: Image retrieval, Google Landmark Recognition, Google Landmark Retrieval, world landmark ID prediction, open-set landmark recognition, extreme class-cardinality visual recognition across 100,000 to 200,000+ landmark classes, fine-grained architectural landmark identification, and metric-learning solution template, modeled as a deterministic pipeline with high-resolution image preprocessing, ArcFace/Sub-center ArcFace or triplet metric learning, ResNet-101/DenseNet-161/EfficientNet-B7/ConvNeXt-XL/DeiT-Large/CLIP ViT-H/14 backbones, GeM pooling, descriptor fusion, embedding extraction, cosine similarity search, DELF/local-feature or spatial verification re-ranking, non-landmark image filtering, landmark ID and confidence calibration, retrieval-augmented classification, cross-modal ArcFace for image-plus-text landmark metadata, and downstream post-processing.
dejargonized_summary: Prepare images for a large world landmark recognition or retrieval task, train a metric-learning model with ArcFace, Sub-center ArcFace, triplet loss, GeM pooling, or strong image and vision-language backbones, extract normalized embeddings, search by cosine similarity, optionally re-rank with local features such as DELF or SuperPoint/RANSAC, reject non-landmark or new classes, and format landmark ID, confidence, or retrieval results.

inputs.name: raw_competition_data
inputs.constraints: Raw data for a Image Retrieval / Metric Learning task.

outputs.name: solution_predictions
outputs.constraints: Final predictions formatted for the benchmark metric.

use_when: The new task has the same broad problem type: image retrieval, Google Landmark Recognition, world landmark ID prediction, open-set landmark recognition, fine-grained architectural landmark identification, whale identification, or visual metric learning.

The available data supports the same ordered transformations and intermediate artifacts as the documented winning pipeline, including image IDs, labels or index/query splits, visual classes, candidate retrieval, or metric-learning embeddings.
The benchmark has extreme class cardinality, 100k/200k+ landmark classes, landmark ID plus confidence outputs, non-landmark images that must be filtered, or Global Average Precision scoring.

Winning techniques include ArcFace, Sub-center ArcFace, cross-modal ArcFace, triplet loss, Siamese networks, hard triplet mining, descriptor fusion, GeM pooling, DELF/local-feature re-ranking, RANSAC geometric verification, query expansion, database augmentation, cosine similarity search, progressive resizing, non-landmark/new-class detection, retrieval-augmented classification, textual-context attention gating, CLIP-style joint encoders, or large-scale backbone ensembles.
Offline batch processing is acceptable, including feature extraction, model ensembling, or post-processing stages.
do_not_use_when: The target task lacks the modality or metadata required by the early pipeline stages.
Strict real-time inference is required and the template depends on heavyweight extraction, retrieval, ensembling, or test-time augmentation.
The evaluation metric rewards a fundamentally different output structure than the source competition.
applicability.key_insight: The load-bearing idea is the pipeline topology: image preprocessing and metric-learning embeddings create a shared visual space that supports retrieval, recognition, re-ranking, and new/non-target class rejection.

swappable_stages.metric_learning_model: Can use ArcFace, Sub-center ArcFace, cross-modal ArcFace, triplet loss, contrastive loss, Siamese networks, GeM pooling, ResNet-101, DenseNet-161, SENet, EfficientNet-B7, ConvNeXt-XL, DeiT-Large, CLIP ViT-H/14, or backbone ensembles if embeddings remain comparable.
swappable_stages.nearest_neighbor_search: Can use exact cosine search, FAISS ANN, class prototypes, kNN voting, thresholding, query expansion, database augmentation, retrieval-augmented classification, or candidate retrieval.
swappable_stages.spatial_verification: The final re-ranking or rejection stage can use DELF, SuperPoint/RANSAC, local feature matching, RANSAC geometric verification, non-landmark detection, new-class detection, textual-context attention gating, or threshold calibration.

applicability.scaling_notes: Scale bottlenecks are usually in feature extraction, nearest-neighbor/retrieval stages, neural model inference, and ensemble evaluation; cache intermediate artifacts when adapting this CDG.
failure_modes: Distribution shift breaks handcrafted thresholds, post-processing rules, or validation-derived weights.
Missing metadata prevents faithful construction of candidates, groups, windows, or cross-validation folds.
A weak first-stage recall step cannot be recovered by downstream rescoring or ensembling.

planning_constraints.subject: preserve_stage_order
planning_constraints.statement: Pipeline stages must execute in the documented order unless a replacement stage preserves the same input/output artifact contract.
planning_constraints.rationale: Downstream stages assume artifacts produced by earlier transformations.

planning_constraints.subject: validation_leakage_guard
planning_constraints.statement: Splits, folds, time ordering, and group boundaries from the source task must be respected when adapting the template.
planning_constraints.rationale: Many winning pipelines depend on leakage-safe validation or temporal grouping.

stages.name: Image preprocessing
stages.description: resize, centrally crop, progressively resize, align object/whale-tail/world-landmark crops, preserve optional landmark text metadata, and prepare high-resolution images across 100k to 200k+ landmark classes for landmark ID and confidence prediction (OpenCV)
stages.dejargonized_description: This stage prepares and optionally aligns images before metric-learning training.

stages.dejargonized_description: This stage trains an image model so visually similar examples are close in embedding space and different classes are separated.
